title: Setup: build Guava at the #7955 parent and fix, run StringsTest, and the fix's test on the parent
description: Setup for llm-dlc/loops/jbmc-java-semantics-gap-brief.md (section 5, organic change), no claims. In the worktrees ~/.cache/in-the-loop/jbmc-java-semantics-gap/src/guava-7955-{parent,fix} (47b7e9e5 and 148cea07), with the project's own Maven wrapper (3.9.9, sha256-pinned), the JDK 24 toolchain Guava asks for (Temurin 24.0.2, checked against Adoptium's sha256 and signature, in the cache) and tests on JDK 21.0.13. Maven's user.home and toolchains.xml point into the cache folder so nothing is written to ~/.m2. Each side builds guava, guava-testlib and guava-tests and runs com.google.common.base.StringsTest, then packages the guava jar to artifacts/guava-7955-SIDE.jar and prints its sha256 and classpath. The fix's StringsTest (which adds the Integer[] lenientFormat assertion) is then run on the parent's code and must fail testLenientFormat; the fix's test is rerun offline; the build trees are removed. Script: ~/.cache/in-the-loop/jbmc-java-semantics-gap/scripts/guava_job.sh (sha256 in the setup record).
expected: StringsTest passes on both sides; on the parent the transplanted fix test fails testLenientFormat with ArrayStoreException; the offline rerun passes; both jars are built

steps.name: the fix's StringsTest on the parent (expected to fail testLenientFormat)
